etymologies.etymologyHTML: From mourn +‎ -ful.

definitions.definition: Filled with grief or sadness; being in a state in which one mourns.

quote.citation: 1845, Edgar Allan Poe, The Fall of the House of Usher:
quote.text: Having deposited our mournful burden upon tressels within this region of horror, we partially turned aside the yet unscrewed lid of the coffin, and looked upon the face of the tenant.
